endorsements.name: Kara Nance
endorsements.label: [KEYNOTE]: The People vs. The Tools: Why Can't We All Just Get Along?
endorsements.description: A plethora of shiny new tools and techniques for solving complex problems are making headlines today with mixed reactions from the crowd.  Popular news regularly mentions AI, blockchain, metaverse, and other terms that were previously jargon – intended for use by professionals!  Everyone has an opinion on the integration of these tools into our world. How do we determine who/what can be trusted to do what?  This presentation will discuss some of the issues facing the roll-out of new tools and approaches in our rapidly evolving digital landscape with a focus on reverse engineering and data science.
